description: Source code for GSTR3BReport class handling GST report generation, including data retrieval, calculations, and report formatting for GST filings in India.

classes.name: GSTR3BReport
classes.description: Main class for generating GSTR 3B GST report, including data validation, retrieval, and report formatting.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the report data by calling get_data.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes all necessary data for the GST report, including supply details, ITC, and missing invoices.

methods.name: set_inward_nil_exempt
methods.description: Sets inward nil/exempt supply details in the report.

methods.name: set_itc_details
methods.description: Calculates and sets Input Tax Credit (ITC) details in the report.

methods.name: get_itc_reversal_entries
methods.description: Retrieves ITC reversal entries from the database.

methods.name: get_itc_details
methods.description: Fetches ITC details from purchase invoices.

methods.name: get_inward_nil_exempt
methods.description: Retrieves inward nil/exempt supplies based on GST state.

methods.name: get_outward_supply_details
methods.description: Fetches outward supply details for sales and purchase invoices.

methods.name: get_outward_tax_invoices
methods.description: Retrieves outward tax invoices based on doctype and reverse charge status.

methods.name: get_outward_items
methods.description: Fetches items associated with outward invoices.

methods.name: get_outward_tax_details
methods.description: Calculates tax details for outward invoices.

methods.name: set_outward_taxable_supplies
methods.description: Sets outward taxable supply details in the report.

methods.name: set_supplies_liable_to_reverse_charge
methods.description: Calculates and sets supplies liable to reverse charge.

methods.name: set_inter_state_supply
methods.description: Classifies and sets inter-state supply details.

methods.name: get_company_gst_details
methods.description: Retrieves GST details for the company address.

methods.name: get_account_heads
methods.description: Fetches account head mappings for GST accounts.

methods.name: get_missing_field_invoices
methods.description: Identifies invoices missing required GST fields.
